title: Musang King Dalam Bonet
subject: a man sneaking two Musang King durians home from a Raub roadside stall in his wife's new car, which she has banned durian from, and trying to air out the boot before she comes downstairs
caption: Malay jersey club dance pop, New Jersey club rhythm crossed with Malay pop melody. Triplet-bounce jersey club kick pattern, squeaky bed-spring percussion hits, rubbery synth bass, bright square-wave synth lead riff, hand claps. Punchy loud club mix. Male lead vocal, mid-high register, comic, clearly sung melody. 140 BPM, F major. Goofy, frantic, danceable mood. No rap verses, no autotune, no trap 808 slides, no dangdut, no ballad section.
lyrics:
[Intro - jersey club kicks, synth lead]

[Verse 1]
Gerai tepi jalan dekat Raub
Dua biji Musang King, bau dah kuat
Kereta baru isteri aku pula
Dia dah pesan, durian jangan bawa

[Pre-Chorus]
Buka tingkap, buka semua
Sembur pewangi, tak jalan juga

[Chorus]
Musang King dalam bonet
Bau dia sampai ke tingkat tiga
Sayang turun, aku pun gelabah
Aku kata itu bau lori sebelah

[Verse 2]
Aku tabur serbuk kopi bawah kerusi
Aku gosok bonet dengan daun pandan
Dia buka pintu, dia hidu sekali
Dia senyum, mana bahagian aku?

[Chorus]
Musang King dalam bonet
Bau dia sampai ke tingkat tiga
Sayang ketawa, minta yang besar
Esok kita pergi Raub berdua

[Outro - kicks, synth riff]
Musang King, Musang King
Kereta baru dah wangi durian
